newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares fall again, seen down on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares fall again, seen down on Tuesday.

text.p: Polish shares fell for the third session running and analysts said the market would likely continue its slight downtrend on Tuesday and beyond in the run-up to September's parliamentary elections.
Analysts said the fact that selling's preponderance after price fixing was only slight for the second session running signalled that the expected falls would be slow.

"Slowly there's starting to be some demand -- some firms have fallen significantly. That doesn't mean we'll have a rebound already tomorrow but there's no panicky sell-off," said Mateusz Andrzejewski, an analyst at Bank Pekao SA brokerage.
